deviation_note: This is an estimate based on standard single-filer federal, FICA, and NJ state calculations. Actual withholding may differ based on your W-4 elections, pre-tax deductions, and other factors. New Jersey has no standard deduction, only a $1,000 personal exemption. New Jersey SDI/FLI (small mandatory payroll deductions, typically well under 1% in recent years) are not modeled here.
